name: Evil Engine
description: Our own game engine SDK in C#: 11 numbered class libraries over Godot 4.7.2 for a full 3D game (world, models, cameras, lights, input, screen, motion, audio); 0.2.0 in the feed; 0.1.0 was the OpenTK 2D engine.

prod.notes: Packages go to the folder feed /mnt/hdd/projects/MyGameFrameWork-data/feed; games pin the exact version.

dev.notes: Runs the demo in Godot 4.7.2 under xvfb on the server (no port); on a desktop open samples/OrbitDemo in Godot and press play.

check.notes: Style, build with warnings as errors, pure and Godot tests, the OrbitDemo in Godot under xvfb (frame 90 and a run driven with real input and recorded audio), no leaks; after a pack scripts/make-a-game-check.sh builds the Make a Game note from the feed.

flow.promote: scripts/check.sh green, bump the version in Directory.Build.props, commit, merge, push, ./scripts/pack.sh from clean main, scripts/make-a-game-check.sh on the feed; games move to the exact version.
rules: Lock-step versions: every package carries the same version.
Packages only from the checked list; Godot pinned at 4.7.2.
The engine reads no config and no environment variable: games pass values to GameBuilder.
Godot types never appear in the public API.
